sources.note: BYO MCP preview needs an internet-reachable endpoint. No current republishing or deletion. Lists supported clients.

sources.note: Work IQ MCP is preview and requires Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing. Separate from arbitrary direct tools.

sources.note: Partner-specific Registered, Observable, and Work IQ capabilities. Preserve coming-soon and Frontier footnotes.

sources.title: Agent 365 SDK overview
sources.note: Explicit registration, identity, tooling, and observability capabilities. Framework support is not a platform connector.

sources.title: Observability data residency, protection, and compliance
sources.note: Tenant default geography, service-generated-data exceptions, 30-day content retention, and no ADR support.

sources.note: Updated 2026-09-15. New standard-harness identities are automatic. Older agents can retain application registrations.

sources.title: Conditional Access for agents
sources.note: Distinguishes OBO user, autonomous agent, and agent-user subjects. API-key paths bypass token issuance and CA.

sources.title: Identity Protection for agents
sources.note: Risky-agent investigation and response. Current agent risk detections are offline.

sources.title: Govern agent identities
sources.note: Sponsors, identity lifecycle, access packages, and licensing. Verify actual resource assignment behavior.

sources.title: Secure Web and AI Gateway for Copilot Studio agents
sources.note: Environment traffic forwarding covers HTTP nodes, custom connectors, and MCP connectors. Baseline policy is tenant-level.

sources.title: Configure prompt injection protection
sources.note: Internet Access routing, TLS inspection, prompt policy, security profile, and CA setup. JSON text only; 64,000-character limit.

sources.title: Enable Defender security for AI agents
sources.note: Security for AI, Microsoft 365 connector, and Copilot Studio onboarding. Use CD3 for current cloud-block evidence behavior.

sources.title: Detect and investigate AI agent threats
sources.note: Public-preview detections depend on telemetry. Foundry threat detection supports published agents only.

sources.title: Configure Defender real-time agent protection
sources.note: Default audit and custom blocking rules. BehaviorInfo records both modes. Blocking rules suppress near-real-time cloud alerts.

sources.title: Transition agent security to Agent 365
sources.note: 2026-07-01 entitlement transition. Recreate affected legacy block rules. Infrastructure/model coverage remains distinct.

sources.title: Configure Copilot Studio external threat protection
sources.note: Generative orchestration only. Per-environment integration, federated authentication, and explicit timeout/error behavior.

sources.title: Assess AI agent posture risk
sources.note: Public-preview posture indicators depend on available data. Not evaluated differs from no known risk.

sources.title: Discover local AI agents with Defender for Endpoint
sources.note: Automatic supported-device discovery; AgentsInfo hunting; user/device/type inventory unit. Companion: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/local-agent-discovery-overview .

sources.title: Endpoint AI agent runtime protection overview
sources.note: Preview native inspection for Claude Code/Codex CLI; OpenClaw network inspection. Pinned and HTTP/3 traffic are excluded.

sources.title: Configure endpoint AI runtime protection
sources.note: PowerShell and Intune configuration, required signature version, permissions, audit/block modes, and fresh-session requirement.

sources.title: Official benign endpoint runtime demonstration
sources.note: Microsoft's harmless test string, Suspicious AI prompt injection alerts, and detection troubleshooting.

sources.title: Purview controls for Agent 365 instances
sources.note: Explicit sharing and VIEW/EXTRACT rights. Outputs do not inherit labels. DLP/compliance scopes differ from audit scope.

sources.title: Purview controls for Copilot Studio
sources.note: Type-specific source labeling, Word/PowerPoint inheritance, SharePoint grounding DLP, and Microsoft Copilot Experiences retention.

sources.title: Foundry compliance and security configuration
sources.note: Current Foundry Purview path. Enforcement requires documented managed inference endpoint and user context. No network isolation.

sources.title: AI security posture management in Defender for Cloud
sources.note: AI infrastructure discovery, recommendations, and attack paths. Cross-cloud infrastructure is not universal agent-content inspection.

sources.title: Enable threat protection for AI services
sources.note: Subscription plan and optional prompt evidence. Its legacy Purview path is deprecated; use CU3 for current integration.

sources.title: Integrate Cloud Apps with Defender for Endpoint
sources.note: Endpoint network logs supply Cloud Discovery. App discovery does not identify every agent or prompt.

sources.title: Govern discovered apps through Defender for Endpoint
sources.note: Scoped profiles, unsanctioned domains, Network Protection, and propagation up to three hours.

sources.title: App governance overview
sources.note: Govern supported OAuth applications and permissions. Does not prove agent prompt or tool coverage.

sources.title: Sentinel Agent 365 connector reference
sources.note: Agent telemetry flows to Sentinel lake. UnifiedAgentObservability is a dataset label, not a documented Log Analytics table contract.

sources.title: Sentinel Microsoft Agent Identities connector definition
sources.note: Explicit preview identity/blueprint asset connector. Separate from Entra sign-in and audit log ingestion.

sources.title: Connect Defender XDR to Sentinel
sources.note: Incident synchronization and selectable raw event ingestion. Unified Defender onboarding enables the connector automatically.

sources.title: Security Copilot E5/E7 inclusion and capacity
sources.note: Phased eligibility; 400 monthly SCUs per 1,000 paid licenses, capped at 10,000. Sentinel lake costs are excluded.

sources.title: Security Copilot in Microsoft Defender
sources.note: Defender Chat preview, incident summaries, and hunting assistance over authorized available data.

sources.title: Defender Agent 365 privacy and retention
sources.note: EU storage for EU/UK tenants; US elsewhere. Session data up to 30 days; inventory/shared security data up to 180 days.

sources.title: Agent 365 Product Terms
sources.note: Integrated receiving services apply their own commitments to copied or processed data.

sources.title: Agent roles and permissions
sources.note: Prefer AI Administrator for agent governance. Reader visibility does not grant management authority.

sources.title: Agent settings
sources.note: Allowed agent types and external-publisher governance.

sources.title: Agent details and activity
sources.note: Permission and metadata views. Activity UI support must not be inferred from generic telemetry integration.

sources.title: Foundry Agent 365 integration by agent type
sources.note: Prompt versus hosted integration matrix. Hosted activity collection requires SDK configuration.

sources.title: Configure Foundry Agent 365 data collection
sources.note: Hosted agents require explicit SDK observability. SDK settings can override resource-level logging disablement.

sources.title: Grant Foundry observability permissions
sources.note: Resolve agentIdentityId; grant Agent365.Observability.OtelWrite to Agent365Observability; verify assignment and propagation.

sources.title: Configure autonomous-agent Conditional Access policies
sources.note: Enhanced agent picker, report-only rollout, agent-risk blocking, and distinct agent-user policy targeting.

sources.title: Send Entra ID logs to Sentinel
sources.note: Connector permissions, log categories, licensing, and documented Log Analytics table mappings.

sources.title: Microsoft 365 Local Agents Frontier controls
sources.note: Native Codex CLI/desktop and Claude Code whole-app blocking unavailable. Extension blocking is a separate Intune surface.

sources.title: Microsoft 365 Shadow AI Frontier controls
sources.note: OpenClaw whole-app blocking can affect all managed Windows devices and shared Node.js processes.

sources.title: Agent 365 Frontier enrollment
sources.note: Preview licensing, terms, and no specific Frontier SLA. Resolve conflicting prerequisite wording before enrollment.

sources.title: Copilot Studio observability integration
sources.note: Automatic telemetry for authenticated, single-tenant sessions. Agent names over 42 characters are not logged.

sources.title: Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
sources.note: Current DLP locations, policy roles, label conditions, and content-processing actions. CU2 limits Studio applicability.

sources.title: Sentinel Agent 365 connector implementation
sources.note: Requires Global Administrator for connection. Defines lake dataset label, with empty sampleQueries and dataTypes.

sources.title: Choose an Agent 365 integration mechanism
sources.note: Distinguishes built-in integration, registry sync preview, and developer SDK integration. Inventory sync is not full instrumentation.
